knowledge:
- key_parameters: data=The input clinical dataset containing numerical and/or categorical features ;; nImputation=Number of imputations to perform if missing values are present (set to NULL if no missing values) ;; dataImputed=Pre-imputed data if available ;; colValidation=Character string specifying the column name of the ground truth/validation labels (e.g., "Diagnosis"), which is excluded from clustering ;; threads=Number of threads for parallel processing ;; simplify=Logical indicating whether to simplify the output ;; stratification_similarity=Threshold (e.g., 0.9) to consider a pair of stratifications as similar ;; paint=Logical indicating whether to paint/highlight similar groups in the Jaccard plot ;; population=Minimum population size threshold (e.g., 0.05) ;; all=Logical indicating whether to return all or only representative stratifications ;; clusters=Vector of stratification names to compare in the Sankey diagram ;; validationData=Logical indicating whether to compare against the validation/ground truth data in the Sankey diagram ;; stratificationName=Vector of selected stratification names to append to the original dataset
- alternatives: None mentioned in the documentation.
- when_to_use: Appropriate for unsupervised patient stratification using clinical datasets containing mixed data types (numerical and categorical), potentially with missing values or correlated variables, where robust and stable patient subgroups need to be identified and validated.
- pitfalls: Ensure character values are correctly transformed into categorical or binary variables during object creation. If missing values are present, appropriate imputation parameters (nImputation or dataImputed) must be configured.

workflows.name: patient_stratification_workflow
workflows.intent: Perform unsupervised patient stratification on clinical data, identify robust cluster representatives, visualize similarities and patient flows, and validate results against ground truth.
input: clinical_data.csv (clinical dataset with mixed numerical/categorical features and optional ground truth column)
workflows.stages: 1. Load clinical data ;; 2. Create the ClustAll object using createClustAll ;; 3. Run the ClustAll clustering pipeline using runClustAll ;; 4. Visualize stratification similarities using plotJACCARD ;; 5. Retrieve representative stratifications using resStratification ;; 6. Compare stratifications or compare against ground truth using plotSANKEY ;; 7. Append selected stratifications to the original dataset using cluster2data ;; 8. Validate stratifications against ground truth using validateStratification
workflows.code:
library(ClustAll)

data("BreastCancerWisconsin", package = "ClustAll") 

data_use <- subset(wdbc, select=-ID)

sum(is.na(data_use)) 
dim(data_use)

obj_noNA <- createClustAll(data = data_use, nImputation = NULL, 
                           dataImputed = NULL, colValidation = "Diagnosis")

obj_noNA1 <- runClustAll(Object = obj_noNA, threads = 2, simplify = FALSE)

obj_noNA1

plotJACCARD(Object = obj_noNA1, stratification_similarity = 0.9, paint = TRUE)

resStratification(Object = obj_noNA1, population = 0.05, 
                  stratification_similarity = 0.9, all = FALSE)

plotSANKEY(Object = obj_noNA1, clusters = c("cuts_c_9","cuts_a_28"), 
           validationData = FALSE)

plotSANKEY(Object = obj_noNA1, clusters = c("cuts_c_9"), 
           validationData = TRUE)

df <- cluster2data(Object = obj_noNA1,
                   stratificationName = c("cuts_c_9","cuts_a_28","cuts_c_4"))
head(df,3)

validateStratification(obj_noNA1, "cuts_a_28")
validateStratification(obj_noNA1, "cuts_c_9")
validateStratification(obj_noNA1, "cuts_c_4")
